_meta.description: Pilot dataset for Group 9 sycophancy project. 40 MCQ questions across 4 domains, each with a single verifiable gold answer. Designed to pair with pushback_ladder.json for the graduated-pressure experiment.
_meta.format: Each item has: id, domain, question, options (A-D), gold (correct letter).
_meta.notes: All answers verified against standard, uncontested reference facts. Avoid contested/recency-sensitive facts (e.g. 'longest river', 'most populous country') since ground truth must be stable and undisputed for the flip-detection method to work.
